moisture_pct.quote: | **Moisture** | **46 %** | JARLSBERG LITE, low-sodium Swiss / Emmenthal type, Norway. 2x 11-lb rindless blocks submitted Nov 1989 to US Customs, analysed by Customs Laboratory New York. Stated composition `having a moisture content of about 46 percent and a fat content of about 15 to 16 percent.` Laboratory found `46 percent moisture, 17.4 percent fat (32.2 percent fat in the dry matter), 32.8 percent protein, and 0.9 percent salt, with a pH of 5.3.` | http://www.faqs.org/rulings/rulings1993NY847749.html |

fat_pct.quote: | **Fat** | **17.4 % (w/w), 32.2 % fat-in-dry-matter** | Same JARLSBERG LITE sample as above. | http://www.faqs.org/rulings/rulings1993NY847749.html |

salt_pct.quote: | **Salt** | **1.1 g / 100 g** | Same TINE Jarlsberg Original as above: `Salt: 1.1 g` | https://scandicandyshop.com/ko/products/jarlsberg-rindless-700g-tine |

ph.quote: | **pH** | **5.3** | Same JARLSBERG LITE Customs sample as above. | http://www.faqs.org/rulings/rulings1993NY847749.html |

ammonia.reason: Low deamination and urease activity in young rindless block with limited surface flora.

animal_barnyard.reason: Pasteurized cow milk and clean Swiss make give very low p-cresol, indole and skatole.

bitter.reason: Low hydrophobic peptides due to moderate rennet proteolysis and debittering peptidases from Propionibacterium.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti inoculation so no C7-C11 methyl ketones.

browning.reason: Residual galactose/lactose plus amino acids give moderate Maillard when heated.

buttery.reason: Diacetyl and acetoin from citrate metabolism by Lactococcus plus milkfat lactones.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Limited lipolysis in pasteurized rennet curd gives low butanoic and hexanoic acids.

creaminess.reason: Reduced fat in Lite type and 46% moisture give smooth but less rich fat-coated mouthfeel.

crumbliness.reason: Cooked pressed elastic curd with CO2 eyes fractures cohesively rather than crumbling.

firmness.reason: Cooked, pressed Swiss-type curd at pH 5.3 with 46% moisture gives elastic semi-firm body.

floral_honey.reason: Low phenylacetaldehyde and 2-phenylethanol from phenylalanine catabolism by starters.

fruity.reason: Ethyl propanoate and ethyl acetate from esterification of propionic and acetic acids by Propionibacterium freudenreichii.

goaty.reason: Cow milk only with no caprine 4-methyloctanoic and 4-ethyloctanoic acids.

malty_nutty.reason: 2-methylbutanal and 3-methylbutanal from leucine/isoleucine catabolism plus propionic acid, signature Swiss nutty note.

melt.reason: pH 5.3 demineralized para-casein with intact network flows well without pasta-filata alignment.

mushroom_earthy.reason: Rindless block without Geotrichum/Brevibacterium gives almost no 1-octen-3-ol or geosmin.

oil_off.reason: Lower 17.4% fat limits free oil release on heating versus full-fat Emmental-type.

smoky.reason: Not smoked so no guaiacol, syringol or cresol from wood pyrolysis.

sour_vinegar.reason: Acetic acid from propionic fermentation and heterofermentative lactate metabolism at pH 5.3.

stretch.reason: Rennet-coagulated non-pasta-filata curd lacks aligned casein fibers for stretching.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Light cooked curd expels whey with only low H2S and methanethiol from methionine.

sweet.reason: Calcium propionate, proline and glycerol from propionic fermentation mask acidity with sweet impression.

umami.reason: Moderate glutamate release from rennet and starter proteolysis during 3-month aging.
